responsibility: Defines the core region inference engine for borrow checking, including region and SCC state, propagation and querying of liveness and outlives information, universe and representative tracking, error-blame selection, and coordination with auxiliary debugging, opaque-type, and SCC analyses. It also owns promotion and checking of NLL type-test subjects when closure requirements are propagated outward. This includes choosing representative regions for type-test subjects, handling unnamed regions, equal regions, bivariant regions inside opaque types, and deciding whether an unsatisfied type test should become a propagated closure outlives requirement rather than a local lifetime error.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this module owns the borrow checker’s region-solving engine itself: it stores region state and SCC results, answers liveness/outlives queries, and derives region errors from solved constraints. It consumes constraint data rather than merely building it (`constraints`), and it is broader than the Polonius fact emitter or diagnostics frontend.
